about_the_game:
Japanese Store Simulator lets you live the dream of running your own shop in the heart of Japan. Build and manage stores that reflect your personality, from cozy manga corners and bustling video game shops to retro arcades full of flashing lights and nostalgia. Mix and match ideas, manage your staff, stock your shelves, and shape the experience of every customer who walks through your doors.

Every corner on your store is yours to customize to the smallest detail. Paint the walls, decorate with plants and posters, and design selfie spots for your visitors. Expand your influence beyond your store by supporting nearby businesses, installing vending machines, or even managing local shrines. As your success grows, reinvest your profits to open new locations and build a thriving commercial empire. Whether you prefer a single beloved shop or a citywide network of stores, the future of your business is entirely in your hands.

Manage your stores

Create the store of your dream, selling market commodities, manga, video games, or make it an arcade if you want, or even a mix of all of the above. You choose how to run your store.

Customize them freely

Paint the walls, add decorations to your store, create selfie areas for your customers.

Invest in your community

Help other businesses in your community grow in exchange for some shares, improving your reputation and revenue.

Install vending machines

Purchase areas around the neighborhood and vending machines, ads, shrines or whatever tickles your fancy.

Expand your empire

Why limit yourself to one store? Once your store is running well, buy a second one, then a third. Customize them to your heart's content. The sky is the limit.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or greater
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 @ 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1070 or AMD Radeon RX Vega 56 4 GB
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard onboard sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or greater
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 @ 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX2060 or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard onboard sound card

short_description: Take Japan by storm with your series of stores, vending machines, arcades and more! Open multiple shops, each customized to your personal specifications and invest in your community.
